vol.name: Superman: The Wedding Album 30th Anniversary Special

title: Superman: The Wedding Album 30th Anniversary Special #1
desc:
CELEBRATE THE WEDDING ANNIVERSARY OF DC'S MOST FAMOUS COUPLE!

Written by Dan Jurgens, Rainbow Rowell, Louise Simonson and Karl Kesel

Art by Dan Jurgens, Jerry Ordway, Cian Tormey, Jon Bogdanove and Tom Grummett

Thirty years ago, the Man of Steel married the incomparable Lois Lane. After crawling his way back from death at the hands of Doomsday, revealing his greatest secret, and surviving a parade of nefarious wedding crashers, the couple lived happily ever after.

Now, in honor of their anniversary, it's up to their Super Son, Jon Kent, to plan a party for his parents with some unwanted help from the fifth dimension.

Can he keep it a secret from them and their enemies hoping to strike while their guards are down?

Join the team behind the historical one-shot along with some exciting new additions for an unforgettable celebration of love and all things super!
